page.layout: One title page: centred title block at the top, a printer's device (woodcut emblem) in the middle, and imprint lines below it. No margin text. Faint mirrored show-through from the reverse side is not transcribed.
page.notes: The title block is very faint and blurred. The large title lines read only partly: "DE" and "BONO FELICI-" are fairly clear, and "RANITATE" is a guess (marked [?]). The smaller lines above and below the title, and the imprint at the foot, cannot be read letter by letter. Their word counts are estimates. A printer's device (woodcut emblem) stands in the centre of the lower half. It is not transcribed. The lines under the device are too faint to read at this resolution. Show-through from the reverse side is visible along the top edge and in the margins. It is not transcribed.
